name: Single source of truth
short_description: The principle that each piece of business information has one authoritative source; the episode frames it less as one storage location and more as one trusted decision reality that defines which source governs which decision.

evidence.quote: This is why the idea of a single source of truth is so often misunderstood by leadership.
The single source of truth properly understood.
acting as the single source of truth for all business data
everyone believed their copy was the single source of truth
